newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Basic Industries Corp wins a contract to provide Egypt with 80,000 tonnes of MTBE.
- Saudi King Fahd urges the private sector to find more jobs for Saudis.
- Saudi Arabia plans 20 new joint-venture projects with France.
- Saudi Arabia to relocate 70 factories from inside Mecca to the outskirts of the town.
- Pakistani trade delegation in Saudi Arabia to promote their country's exports.
